name: זְמִירָה
summary: A son of Becher son of Benjamin (1Ch 7:8). The name has the form of a noun “song” beside זָמִיר and זִמְרָה; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “The sons of Becher: זְמִירָה and Joash and Eliezer …”
“With זְמִרוֹת let us shout to him”: the songs the name's form is read from.

note: A reading of the form only.
